subject: Covariable fixed effect divided by spatial divisions

messages.author: 6d154e43d7ddc6e2
messages.subject: Covariable fixed effect divided by spatial divisions
parts:
Dear INLA community,

I'm running a Bayesian model for representing disease incidence in a spatial and temporal division adding a set of covariables. I obtained the fixed effect of each variable using the next model:

model.1<- incidence ~ 1 +  f(spatial ,model="bym",graph=FOZ3.adj) +  f(temporal ,model="rw1") + variable_1 + variable_2 + ... + variable_n

I want to obtain a fixed effect for each variable divided by spatial division for studying the effect of each variable over a specific area. How can I do that?

Thank you.

Sincerely.

Mario.
